content.short: beaconcha.in is an open-source Ethereum explorer for validators.
content.description: beaconcha.in is an open-source Ethereum explorer designed to be approachable for both technical and non-technical users. In addition to its web interface, it provides an open-source mobile app for iOS and Android, allowing you to monitor validators on the go. The explorer integrates the consensus layer and the execution layer in a single, unified view, giving a cohesive way to examine network activity and validator data from one place.
